description: This source file contains JUnit test cases for the PatientDataUnvoidHandler class in the OpenMRS project. The tests verify that the handler correctly unvoids patients, encounters, orders, and cohort memberships, restoring their voided state.

classes.name: PatientDataUnvoidHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of PatientDataUnvoidHandler in unvoiding patients and related entities.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnvoidTheOrdersAndEncountersAssociatedWithThePatient
methods.description: Tests that the handler correctly unvoids all encounters and orders related to a patient that was previously voided.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotUnvoidTheOrdersAndEncountersThatNeverGotVoidedWithThePatient
methods.description: Ensures that encounters and orders that were not voided are not affected when unvoiding a patient.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnvoidMembersAssociatedWithThePatient
methods.description: Verifies that cohort memberships associated with a voided patient are also unvoided properly.
